content:
olivia_pm: Quick alignment thread for GA operational acceptance (target: next quarter). Need clear pass/fail criteria for SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing. What's blocking?

ashish_eng: Main technical tradeoff: p99 latency vs batching efficiency. Tighter p99 hurts throughput and increases cost.

eva_doc: Docs mostly ready. Missing explicit SLA scope text and dedicated vs hosted behavior examples. Also need KMS/on-prem sample configs.

maria_support: Support readiness: require L2 playbook, escalation matrix, and an oncall rota. Training slot for L2 before GA.

kevin_finops: Pricing question: publish burst tiers or keep bursts negotiated? Need a simple overage formula for the public doc.

nate_oncall: Pager thresholds draft: P0 = cluster down (page). P1 = p99 > 2x baseline for >5m (page). P2 = error spike >3% for 10m (Slack). Rotation: 1-week primary/secondary.

olivia_pm: Proposed GA acceptance checklist (owners):
- SLA: hosted uptime + p99 target, credit calc (owner: kevin_finops, due 3d)
- Docs: public GA guide + internal runbook (owner: eva_doc, due EOD Thu)
- Support: L2 playbook + rota (owner: maria_support, due 5d)
- Monitoring: dashboards + synthetic E2E checks (owner: ashish_eng, due 4d)
- Pricing: tiers + overage policy (owner: kevin_finops + sales, due 4d)

ashish_eng: Monitoring notes: need synthetic tests for streaming and non-streaming, KV cache metrics, and a dashboard showing batching efficiency vs latency.

kevin_finops: SLA proposal: Hosted only SLA 99.95% uptime; p99 latency target 250ms for common small-model routes. Dedicated handled in contracts. Credit calc draft: credits = min(1, downtime_minutes / 60) * committed_percent. Will post numbers.

nate_oncall: Agree Hosted-only SLA reduces noise. Will make a PR for pager rules.

maria_support: I'll prepare the L2 playbook template and pair with eva_doc to extract public/privileged sections.

eva_doc: I'll add KMS snippet and model pin/fallback examples. Sample KMS YAML added to internal draft.

olivia_pm: Decisions for this week: 1) Hosted-only SLA? 2) p99 target 200ms vs 250ms? 3) publish burst tiers up to 40%?

ashish_eng: Vote: Hosted-only SLA, p99 250ms to avoid throughput loss.

kevin_finops: Agree. Publish burst tiers 0-40% at a fixed premium; above 40% escalates to sales.

olivia_pm: Consensus: Hosted SLA 99.95% uptime, p99 250ms. Dedicated via contract. Pricing: publish burst tier up to 40%. Owners and deadlines above. Please comment by EOD if objections, otherwise I'll convert to GA board checklist. :thumbsup:

ashish_eng: Acknowledged, will update monitoring tasks.

eva_doc: Updating docs now.

maria_support: Starting rota + playbook.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy check: 8/10 smoke checks passed.

kevin_finops: Posting SLA credit calc soon.

nate_oncall: Pager PR incoming.

olivia_pm: Thanks all, I'll create the GA checklist items and assign.
